articles.summary: Parsons Corporation, a leading infrastructure engineering firm, has announced that its joint venture, Riyadh Metro Transit Consultants (RMTC), in partnership with Systra and Egis, has secured the contract to provide project and construction management services for the Riyadh Metro Red Line Extension. articles.summary: A US-French consortium led by Parsons Corporation has won management of the $2.75 billion Riyadh Metro Red Line extension. The Royal Commission for Riyadh City picked the group, Riyadh Metro Transit Consultants, in March. The appointment was announced on Monday by Parsons.
